steps.description: Hands hold the tomato under running water in the sink, rubbing and rinsing it clean.
steps.title: Wash the tomato

steps.description: Hands strip leaves from stems and chop the fresh green herbs finely on the cutting board.
steps.title: Chop the fresh herbs

steps.description: Hands crack a white egg and drop its contents into the small blue mixing bowl.
steps.title: Crack the egg into bowl

steps.description: Hands steady the washed tomato and cut it in half with a knife on the cutting board.
steps.title: Halve the tomato

steps.description: Hands transfer chopped herbs into the bowl with the egg and add measured black pepper.
steps.title: Combine herbs and seasoning with egg

steps.description: Hands whisk the egg, herbs, and seasoning together in the blue bowl using a fork.
steps.title: Whisk the herb egg mixture

steps.description: Hands measure oil and pour it into the small frying pan on the stove.
steps.title: Add oil to the frying pan

steps.description: Hands tilt and swirl the frying pan to coat it with hot oil and check the heat.
steps.title: Heat and coat the pan

steps.description: Hands place the two tomato halves cut-side down into the hot oiled frying pan.
steps.title: Place tomatoes in the pan

steps.description: Hands retrieve a white plate and wipe it clean with a paper towel.
steps.title: Prepare the serving plate

steps.description: Hands turn, press, and tend the tomatoes in the frying pan with spatula and fork as they fry.
steps.title: Fry and turn the tomatoes

steps.description: Hands lift the fried tomato halves from the pan and set them onto the plate.
steps.title: Transfer fried tomatoes to plate

steps.description: Hands pour the whisked herb egg mixture from the blue bowl into the hot frying pan.
steps.title: Pour egg mixture into pan

steps.description: Hands stir, shape, and cook the herb egg mixture in the pan until set as an omelet.
steps.title: Cook the herb omelet

steps.description: Hands slide the cooked herb omelet from the frying pan onto the plate beside the tomatoes.
steps.title: Plate the herb omelet

task_summary: Prepare herb omelet with fried tomatoes by washing and halving tomato, chopping herbs, mixing egg with herbs and seasoning, frying tomatoes, then cooking the omelet and plating together.
